question_en: Which statements are true? 1) The current is the same in conductors connected in series. 2) In a parallel connection the total resistance is greater than the largest one. 3) An ammeter is connected in series. 4) The resistance of a voltmeter must be very small.
question_uz: Qaysi fikrlar to'g'ri? 1) Ketma-ket ulangan o'tkazgichlarda tok kuchi bir xil. 2) Parallel ulashda umumiy qarshilik eng katta qarshilikdan katta. 3) Ampermetr zanjirga ketma-ket ulanadi. 4) Voltmetrning qarshiligi juda kichik bo'lishi kerak.
question_ru: Какие утверждения верны? 1) В последовательно соединённых проводниках сила тока одинакова. 2) При параллельном соединении общее сопротивление больше наибольшего. 3) Амперметр включают в цепь последовательно. 4) Сопротивление вольтметра должно быть очень малым.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. 1 va 3 to'g'ri. Parallel ulashda umumiy qarshilik eng kichigidan ham kichik; voltmetr qarshiligi katta bo'lishi kerak.
Asos: ulash qoidalari.

en: 2 is false: smaller than the smallest. $$\frac{1}{R}=\frac{1}{R_1}+\frac{1}{R_2}$$
4 is false: for a voltmeter $R_V$ is large.

rules.en: Ammeter in series, voltmeter in parallel

distractors.A: 2-fikr noto'g'ri: parallel ulashda umumiy qarshilik eng kichigidan kichik
distractors.D: 4-fikr noto'g'ri: voltmetr qarshiligi katta bo'lishi kerak

distractors_ru.A: утверждение 2 неверно: при параллельном соединении общее сопротивление меньше наименьшего
distractors_ru.D: утверждение 4 неверно: сопротивление вольтметра должно быть большим

distractors_en.A: statement 2 is false: in parallel the total resistance is smaller than the smallest one
distractors_en.D: statement 4 is false: a voltmeter must have a large resistance
distractors_en.E: statement 4 is false and statement 1 is true

question_en: Resistors of $14\ \Omega$, $26\ \Omega$ and $R_3$ are connected in series. Find $R_3$ ($\Omega$) if the total resistance is $75\ \Omega$.
question_uz: Qarshiliklari $14\ \Omega$, $26\ \Omega$ va $R_3$ bo'lgan rezistorlar ketma-ket ulangan. Umumiy qarshilik $75\ \Omega$ bo'lsa, $R_3$ ni toping ($\Omega$).
question_ru: Резисторы сопротивлениями $14\ \Omega$, $26\ \Omega$ и $R_3$ соединены последовательно. Найдите $R_3$ ($\Omega$), если общее сопротивление равно $75\ \Omega$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. Ketma-ket ulashda R = R₁ + R₂ + R₃, demak R₃ = 75 − 14 − 26 = 35 Ω.
Asos: R = R₁ + R₂ + R₃.

distractors_en.B: only the two known resistances were added

question_en: Resistors of $20\ \Omega$ and $30\ \Omega$ are connected in parallel. Find the total resistance ($\Omega$).
question_uz: Qarshiliklari $20\ \Omega$ va $30\ \Omega$ bo'lgan rezistorlar parallel ulangan. Umumiy qarshilikni toping ($\Omega$).
question_ru: Резисторы сопротивлениями $20\ \Omega$ и $30\ \Omega$ соединены параллельно. Найдите общее сопротивление ($\Omega$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. R = R₁R₂/(R₁ + R₂) = 20·30/50 = 12 Ω — eng kichik qarshilikdan ham kichik.
Asos: parallel ulash formulasi.

question_en: Resistors of $10\ \Omega$, $20\ \Omega$ and $30\ \Omega$ are connected in series to a voltage of $120\ \mathrm{V}$. Find the voltage across the $20\ \Omega$ resistor ($\mathrm{V}$).
question_uz: Qarshiliklari $10\ \Omega$, $20\ \Omega$ va $30\ \Omega$ bo'lgan rezistorlar ketma-ket ulanib, $120\ \mathrm{V}$ kuchlanishga ulangan. $20\ \Omega$ li rezistordagi kuchlanishni toping ($\mathrm{V}$).
question_ru: Резисторы сопротивлениями $10\ \Omega$, $20\ \Omega$ и $30\ \Omega$ соединены последовательно и подключены к напряжению $120\ \mathrm{V}$. Найдите напряжение на резисторе $20\ \Omega$ ($\mathrm{V}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. R = 10 + 20 + 30 = 60 Ω; I = 120/60 = 2 A; U₂ = IR₂ = 2·20 = 40 V.
Asos: ketma-ket ulashda tok bir xil.

distractors.C: 120 V faqat 20 Ω ga bo'lingan — bu kuchlanish emas
distractors.E: butun kuchlanish bitta rezistorga tushadi deb olingan

distractors_ru.C: 120 V разделено только на 20 Ω — это не напряжение
distractors_ru.E: принято, что всё напряжение падает на одном резисторе

distractors_en.A: the voltage across the 10 Ω resistor was found
distractors_en.B: the voltage across the 30 Ω resistor was found
distractors_en.C: 120 V was divided by 20 Ω only — this is not a voltage
distractors_en.E: the whole voltage was assumed to fall on one resistor

question_en: Resistors of $15\ \Omega$ and $60\ \Omega$ are connected in parallel. The current in the first resistor is $2\ \mathrm{A}$. Find the current in the unbranched part of the circuit ($\mathrm{A}$).
question_uz: Qarshiliklari $15\ \Omega$ va $60\ \Omega$ bo'lgan rezistorlar parallel ulangan. Birinchi rezistordagi tok kuchi $2\ \mathrm{A}$. Zanjirning tarmoqlanmagan qismidagi tok kuchini toping ($\mathrm{A}$).
question_ru: Резисторы сопротивлениями $15\ \Omega$ и $60\ \Omega$ соединены параллельно. Сила тока в первом резисторе $2\ \mathrm{A}$. Найдите силу тока в неразветвлённой части цепи ($\mathrm{A}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. U = I₁R₁ = 2·15 = 30 V; I₂ = 30/60 = 0.5 A; I = I₁ + I₂ = 2.5 A.
Asos: parallel ulashda kuchlanish bir xil, toklar qo'shiladi.

uz: Ikkinchi tarmoq va umumiy tok: $$I_2=\frac{30}{60}=0.5\ \mathrm{A},\qquad I=2+0.5=2.5\ \mathrm{A}$$
ru: Вторая ветвь и общий ток: $$I_2=\frac{30}{60}=0.5\ \mathrm{A},\qquad I=2+0.5=2.5\ \mathrm{A}$$
en: The second branch and the total current: $$I_2=\frac{30}{60}=0.5\ \mathrm{A},\qquad I=2+0.5=2.5\ \mathrm{A}$$

distractors.B: tok qarshilikka to'g'ri proporsional deb olingan
distractors.C: ikkinchi tok 8 A deb olinib qo'shilgan

distractors_ru.A: найден только ток во второй ветви
distractors_ru.B: принято, что ток прямо пропорционален сопротивлению
distractors_ru.C: второй ток принят равным 8 A и сложен

distractors_en.A: only the current in the second branch was found
distractors_en.B: the current was taken as directly proportional to the resistance
distractors_en.C: the second current was taken as 8 A and added
distractors_en.D: the current of the second branch was ignored

question_en: In the circuit shown, $R_1=7\ \Omega$, $R_2=12\ \Omega$, $R_3=4\ \Omega$. Find the total resistance between points $A$ and $B$ ($\Omega$).
question_uz: Rasmdagi zanjirda $R_1=7\ \Omega$, $R_2=12\ \Omega$, $R_3=4\ \Omega$. $A$ va $B$ nuqtalar orasidagi umumiy qarshilikni toping ($\Omega$).
question_ru: В цепи на рисунке $R_1=7\ \Omega$, $R_2=12\ \Omega$, $R_3=4\ \Omega$. Найдите общее сопротивление между точками $A$ и $B$ ($\Omega$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. R₂ va R₃ parallel: 12·4/16 = 3 Ω; R₁ ularga ketma-ket: R = 7 + 3 = 10 Ω.
Asos: aralash ulash bosqichma-bosqich soddalashtiriladi.

distractors.D: parallel guruh uchun o'rtacha qiymat 8 Ω olingan

distractors_ru.D: для параллельной группы взято среднее 8 Ω

distractors_en.A: all three resistors were taken as in series
distractors_en.C: all three resistors were taken as in parallel
distractors_en.D: the average 8 Ω was taken for the parallel group
distractors_en.E: only the parallel group was calculated

question_en: $6$ resistors of $18\ \Omega$ each are connected first in series and then in parallel. How many times is the total resistance in series greater than in parallel?
question_uz: Har birining qarshiligi $18\ \Omega$ bo'lgan $6$ ta rezistor avval ketma-ket, keyin parallel ulandi. Ketma-ket ulangandagi umumiy qarshilik parallel ulangandagidan necha marta katta?
question_ru: $6$ резисторов сопротивлением $18\ \Omega$ каждый соединили сначала последовательно, затем параллельно. Во сколько раз общее сопротивление при последовательном соединении больше, чем при параллельном?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. Ketma-ket: 6·18 = 108 Ω; parallel: 18/6 = 3 Ω; nisbat 108/3 = 36 = n².
Asos: R = nR₁ va R = R₁/n.

en: In series and in parallel: $$R'=6\cdot18=108\ \Omega,\qquad R''=\frac{18}{6}=3\ \Omega$$

distractors.A: nisbat n ga teng deb olingan
distractors.D: bu ketma-ket ulangandagi qarshilik, nisbat emas
distractors.E: bu parallel ulangandagi qarshilik, nisbat emas

distractors_ru.D: это сопротивление при последовательном соединении, а не отношение
distractors_ru.E: это сопротивление при параллельном соединении, а не отношение

distractors_en.A: the ratio was taken as n
distractors_en.D: this is the series resistance, not the ratio
distractors_en.E: this is the parallel resistance, not the ratio

question_en: Currents $I_1=4\ \mathrm{A}$ and $I_2=1.5\ \mathrm{A}$ enter a node, currents $I_3=2\ \mathrm{A}$, $I_4=0.5\ \mathrm{A}$ and $I_5$ leave it. Find $I_5$ ($\mathrm{A}$).
question_uz: Tugunga $I_1=4\ \mathrm{A}$ va $I_2=1.5\ \mathrm{A}$ toklar kiradi, undan $I_3=2\ \mathrm{A}$, $I_4=0.5\ \mathrm{A}$ va $I_5$ toklar chiqadi. $I_5$ ni toping ($\mathrm{A}$).
question_ru: В узел входят токи $I_1=4\ \mathrm{A}$ и $I_2=1.5\ \mathrm{A}$, выходят токи $I_3=2\ \mathrm{A}$, $I_4=0.5\ \mathrm{A}$ и $I_5$. Найдите $I_5$ ($\mathrm{A}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. Kirgan toklar yig'indisi chiqqanlariga teng: 4 + 1.5 = 2 + 0.5 + I₅, I₅ = 3 A.
Asos: tugun qoidasi (zaryadning saqlanishi).

distractors.E: ikkinchi va to'rtinchi toklarning ishorasi almashgan

distractors_ru.E: перепутаны знаки второго и четвёртого токов

distractors_en.C: only the known outgoing currents were added
distractors_en.D: only the incoming currents were added
distractors_en.E: the signs of the second and fourth currents were swapped

question_en: In the circuit shown, resistors $R$ and $3R$ are connected in series and the switch $K$ is in parallel with the resistor $3R$. The voltage is constant. How many times does the ammeter reading increase when the switch is closed?
question_uz: Rasmdagi zanjirda $R$ va $3R$ rezistorlar ketma-ket ulangan, $K$ kalit $3R$ rezistorga parallel. Kuchlanish o'zgarmas. Kalit ulansa, ampermetrning ko'rsatishi necha marta ortadi?
question_ru: В цепи на рисунке резисторы $R$ и $3R$ соединены последовательно, ключ $K$ параллелен резистору $3R$. Напряжение постоянно. Во сколько раз возрастёт показание амперметра при замыкании ключа?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. Kalit ochiq: I₁ = U/(R + 3R) = U/4R. Kalit ulansa 3R qisqa tutashadi: I₂ = U/R. Nisbat 4.
Asos: qisqa tutashgan rezistordan tok o'tmaydi.

rules.ru: Через закороченный резистор ток не идёт
rules.en: No current in a short-circuited resistor

distractors.A: kalit R ni qisqa tutashtiradi deb olingan
distractors.E: ikki rezistordan biri qolgani uchun 2 marta deyilgan

distractors_ru.E: сказано «в 2 раза», так как остался один резистор из двух

distractors_en.A: the switch was assumed to short-circuit R
distractors_en.B: the ratio of the resistances was taken
distractors_en.E: «2 times» was said because one of two resistors remained

question_en: An ammeter of resistance $0.36\ \Omega$ is designed to measure currents up to $1\ \mathrm{A}$. What shunt resistance is needed to measure currents up to $10\ \mathrm{A}$ with it ($\Omega$)?
question_uz: Qarshiligi $0.36\ \Omega$ bo'lgan ampermetr $1\ \mathrm{A}$ gacha tokni o'lchashga mo'ljallangan. U bilan $10\ \mathrm{A}$ gacha tokni o'lchash uchun qanday qarshilikli shunt ulash kerak ($\Omega$)?
question_ru: Амперметр сопротивлением $0.36\ \Omega$ рассчитан на измерение тока до $1\ \mathrm{A}$. Шунт какого сопротивления нужно подключить, чтобы измерять им ток до $10\ \mathrm{A}$ ($\Omega$)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. n = 10/1 = 10; shunt qarshiligi 0.36/(n − 1) = 0.36/9 = 0.04 Ω.
Asos: shuntdan (n − 1) qism tok o'tadi.

distractors.A: qarshilik n − 1 ga ko'paytirilgan (qo'shimcha qarshilik formulasi)

distractors_ru.A: сопротивление умножено на n − 1 (формула добавочного сопротивления)

distractors_en.A: the resistance was multiplied by n − 1 (additional-resistance formula)
distractors_en.B: divided by n instead of n − 1
distractors_en.C: the resistance was multiplied by n

question_en: A voltmeter of resistance $800\ \Omega$ measures voltages up to $6\ \mathrm{V}$. What additional resistance must be connected to measure voltages up to $30\ \mathrm{V}$ with it ($\Omega$)?
question_uz: Qarshiligi $800\ \Omega$ bo'lgan voltmetr $6\ \mathrm{V}$ gacha kuchlanishni o'lchaydi. U bilan $30\ \mathrm{V}$ gacha kuchlanishni o'lchash uchun qanday qo'shimcha qarshilik ulash kerak ($\Omega$)?
question_ru: Вольтметр сопротивлением $800\ \Omega$ измеряет напряжение до $6\ \mathrm{V}$. Какое добавочное сопротивление нужно подключить, чтобы измерять им напряжение до $30\ \mathrm{V}$ ($\Omega$)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. n = 30/6 = 5; qo'shimcha qarshilik (n − 1)·800 = 4·800 = 3200 Ω.
Asos: qo'shimcha qarshilikka (n − 1) qism kuchlanish tushadi.

distractors_en.A: multiplied by n instead of n − 1
distractors_en.C: the resistance was divided by n
distractors_en.E: n + 1 was taken instead of n − 1

question_en: A thermistor and a $500\ \Omega$ resistor are connected in series to a voltage of $12\ \mathrm{V}$. At room temperature the current is $4\ \mathrm{mA}$, and when the thermistor is heated it is $12\ \mathrm{mA}$. How many times has the resistance of the thermistor decreased?
question_uz: Termistor va $500\ \Omega$ li rezistor ketma-ket ulanib, $12\ \mathrm{V}$ kuchlanishga ulangan. Xona haroratida tok kuchi $4\ \mathrm{mA}$, termistor qizdirilganda $12\ \mathrm{mA}$ bo'ldi. Termistor qarshiligi necha marta kamaygan?
question_ru: Термистор и резистор $500\ \Omega$ соединены последовательно и подключены к напряжению $12\ \mathrm{V}$. При комнатной температуре сила тока $4\ \mathrm{mA}$, при нагревании термистора — $12\ \mathrm{mA}$. Во сколько раз уменьшилось сопротивление термистора?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. Umumiy qarshilik: 12/0.004 = 3000 Ω va 12/0.012 = 1000 Ω. Termistor: 2500 Ω va 500 Ω; 2500/500 = 5.
Asos: R = U/I, ketma-ket ulash.

distractors.A: toklar nisbati olingan — rezistor hisobga olinmagan
distractors.B: 2500 Ω qizigan holatdagi umumiy 1000 Ω ga bo'lingan
distractors.D: qizigan holatdagi umumiy 1000 Ω ni 500 Ω ga bo'lgan
distractors.E: sovuq holatdagi umumiy 3000 Ω ni 500 Ω ga bo'lgan

distractors_ru.A: взято отношение токов — резистор не учтён
distractors_ru.B: 2500 Ω разделено на общее 1000 Ω в нагретом состоянии
distractors_ru.D: общее 1000 Ω в нагретом состоянии разделено на 500 Ω
distractors_ru.E: общее 3000 Ω в холодном состоянии разделено на 500 Ω

distractors_en.A: the ratio of the currents was taken — the resistor was ignored
distractors_en.B: 2500 Ω was divided by the total 1000 Ω of the heated state
distractors_en.D: the total 1000 Ω of the heated state was divided by 500 Ω
distractors_en.E: the total 3000 Ω of the cold state was divided by 500 Ω

question_en: A ring is made of a uniform wire of resistance $32\ \Omega$. Points $A$ and $B$ in the figure divide the length of the ring in the ratio $1:3$. Find the resistance between $A$ and $B$ ($\Omega$).
question_uz: Qarshiligi $32\ \Omega$ bo'lgan bir jinsli simdan halqa yasalgan. Rasmdagi $A$ va $B$ nuqtalar halqa uzunligini $1:3$ nisbatda bo'ladi. $A$ va $B$ orasidagi qarshilikni toping ($\Omega$).
question_ru: Из однородного провода сопротивлением $32\ \Omega$ сделано кольцо. Точки $A$ и $B$ на рисунке делят длину кольца в отношении $1:3$. Найдите сопротивление между $A$ и $B$ ($\Omega$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. Yoylar qarshiligi 8 Ω va 24 Ω, ular parallel: 8·24/32 = 6 Ω.
Asos: ikki nuqta orasidagi ikki yo'l parallel ulangan.

distractors_en.B: the resistance of the whole ring was taken
distractors_en.C: half of the ring was taken
distractors_en.D: only the resistance of the short arc was taken
distractors_en.E: only the resistance of the long arc was taken

question_en: Two voltmeters of resistances $4\ \mathrm{k}\Omega$ and $6\ \mathrm{k}\Omega$ are connected in series to a voltage of $220\ \mathrm{V}$. What does the first voltmeter read ($\mathrm{V}$)?
question_uz: Qarshiliklari $4\ \mathrm{k}\Omega$ va $6\ \mathrm{k}\Omega$ bo'lgan ikkita voltmetr ketma-ket ulanib, $220\ \mathrm{V}$ kuchlanishga ulangan. Birinchi voltmetr nimani ko'rsatadi ($\mathrm{V}$)?
question_ru: Два вольтметра сопротивлениями $4\ \mathrm{k}\Omega$ и $6\ \mathrm{k}\Omega$ соединены последовательно и подключены к напряжению $220\ \mathrm{V}$. Что показывает первый вольтметр ($\mathrm{V}$)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. Ketma-ket ulangan voltmetrlar kuchlanishni qarshiliklariga proporsional bo'ladi: 220·4/(4 + 6) = 88 V.
Asos: U₁/U₂ = R₁/R₂.

en: A voltmeter is a resistor; a voltage divider: $$U_1=U\frac{R_1}{R_1+R_2}=220\cdot\frac{4}{10}=88\ \mathrm{V}$$

distractors.C: har bir voltmetr to'la kuchlanishni ko'rsatadi deb olingan

distractors_ru.C: принято, что каждый вольтметр показывает полное напряжение
distractors_ru.E: напряжение лишь разделено на сумму сопротивлений

distractors_en.A: the voltage was assumed to be shared equally
distractors_en.B: this is the reading of the second voltmeter
distractors_en.C: each voltmeter was assumed to show the full voltage
distractors_en.E: the voltage was only divided by the sum of the resistances

question_en: Resistors $R_1=2\ \mathrm{k}\Omega$ and $R_2=3\ \mathrm{k}\Omega$ are connected in series to a constant voltage of $100\ \mathrm{V}$. A voltmeter of resistance $6\ \mathrm{k}\Omega$ is connected in parallel with $R_2$. What does the voltmeter read ($\mathrm{V}$)?
question_uz: $R_1=2\ \mathrm{k}\Omega$ va $R_2=3\ \mathrm{k}\Omega$ rezistorlar ketma-ket ulanib, $100\ \mathrm{V}$ o'zgarmas kuchlanishga ulangan. $R_2$ ga qarshiligi $6\ \mathrm{k}\Omega$ bo'lgan voltmetr parallel ulandi. Voltmetr nimani ko'rsatadi ($\mathrm{V}$)?
question_ru: Резисторы $R_1=2\ \mathrm{k}\Omega$ и $R_2=3\ \mathrm{k}\Omega$ соединены последовательно и подключены к постоянному напряжению $100\ \mathrm{V}$. Параллельно $R_2$ подключили вольтметр сопротивлением $6\ \mathrm{k}\Omega$. Что показывает вольтметр ($\mathrm{V}$)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. R₂ va voltmetr parallel: 3·6/9 = 2 kΩ. Kuchlanish bo'lgichi: 100·2/(2 + 2) = 50 V.
Asos: real voltmetr — rezistor.

en: $R_2$ and the voltmeter are in parallel: $$R_{2V}=\frac{3\cdot6}{3+6}=2\ \mathrm{k}\Omega$$

rules.en: A voltmeter is a resistor of resistance $R_V$

distractors.B: ideal holda birinchi rezistordagi kuchlanish topilgan
distractors.C: parallel guruh o'rniga voltmetr qarshiligi olingan: 100·6/8
distractors.D: voltmetr manba kuchlanishini ko'rsatadi deb olingan

distractors_ru.B: найдено напряжение на первом резисторе в идеальном случае
distractors_ru.C: вместо параллельной группы взято сопротивление вольтметра: 100·6/8
distractors_ru.D: принято, что вольтметр показывает напряжение источника

distractors_en.A: the voltmeter was taken as ideal: 100·3/5
distractors_en.B: the voltage across the first resistor in the ideal case was found
distractors_en.C: the voltmeter resistance was used instead of the parallel group: 100·6/8
distractors_en.D: the voltmeter was assumed to show the source voltage
